candidates.basis: NL5 owner/target hints; exact source inventory; closed transition inventory; inspection and verification initial-entry facts.
candidates.expected: The InMotion scope initially enters Accelerating through an owner-local initial edge.
candidates.observed: No InMotion-owned initial pseudostate edge exists; transition:line:32 is an ordinary InMotion-to-Accelerating transition.

candidates.basis: NL9 progress wording; exact lifecycle/action inventory; outgoing transition inventory for Approaching; reachable-state facts.
candidates.expected: Approaching continues to approach the destination while active.
candidates.observed: Approaching has only entry action Decelerate and outgoing transitions to Stopping and final; no explicit continued-approach action or effect is supplied.
candidates.reason: The state is reachable and has two outgoing transitions, so it is not a finite no-outgoing deadlock frontier. However, the closed model provides no explicit action/effect representing continued approach; the available behavior only responds to Ready to Stop or Destination Missed. This precise continuation obligation is not expressible by a frozen predicate.
candidates.requirement_quote: continues to approach the destination
candidates.strongest_rebuttal: The entry action Decelerate and outgoing responses could be interpreted as sufficient implementation of continued approach, but the supplied model facts do not explicitly establish that semantic equivalence.
candidates.title: Approaching Lacks Explicit Operational Continuation

candidates.basis: NL10 termination obligation; exact Approaching outgoing transitions; reachable target and root-final topology; finite verification facts.
candidates.expected: The Approaching retention obligation ends when the system is ready to stop or decelerate.
candidates.observed: Approaching has Ready_to_Stop -> Stopping and Destination_Missed -> root final; no supplied continuation from the completion targets is shown.
candidates.reason: Approaching has an exact transition to Stopping on Ready to Stop and another transition to the root final state on Destination Missed. The target Stopping state is reachable and has no outgoing transition, while the root-final branch terminates. The supplied facts do not show a re-entry or continued route from the designated completion path; therefore no termination violation is established.
candidates.requirement_quote: until it is ready to stop or decelerate
candidates.strongest_rebuttal: The exact outgoing completion routes and absence of target continuations support stable completion rather than a termination defect.
candidates.title: Approaching Does Not Establish Stable Termination

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL3, exact EmergencyStopping/action/event bindings, source lifecycle mapping, and closed-model action observation.
decisions.reason: The NL3 clause requires EmergencyStopping to include the Emergency Stop action in the specified lifecycle context. The exact state, transition, and event are bound, and the closed model exposes EmergencyStop as an abstract entry action, but the obligation does not type an explicit action phase. The source places the action on entry, while the frozen candidate does not provide a phase field; these two compatible scope readings prevent deciding whether the observed action satisfies the precise requirement.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The source lifecycle mapping and PlantUML placement support treating Emergency Stop as an entry action for EmergencyStopping, which could satisfy the action obligation if entry is the intended phase.
decisions.violated_obligation: EmergencyStopping includes the Emergency Stop action in the source-required lifecycle context.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL3 effect clause, exact EmergencyStopping/state/event/transition bindings, and complete supplied effect observations.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires EmergencyStopping to send the Obstacle Detected signal. The exact EmergencyStopping state is bound, while the supplied closed-model inventory shows no state effect or transition effect carrying Obstacle Detected; the only outgoing transition is Obstacle_Cleared with an empty effect list. Event declaration and use as an incoming trigger do not establish emission, so no competent alternative reading rebuts the missing effect.
decisions.violated_obligation: EmergencyStopping sends the Obstacle Detected signal.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL5 initial-entry clause, exact InMotion and Accelerating bindings, owner-local initial-edge inventory, and S2 facts.
decisions.reason: The NL5 clause requires the InMotion scope to initially enter Accelerating. The exact owner and target are bound, and the owner-local initial transition inventory has no target, with matching edges to Accelerating marked conditional. A child-region edge or guarded routing edge would be a different property and does not satisfy the exact owner-local default-entry requirement.
decisions.violated_obligation: The InMotion scope initially enters Accelerating.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL2 continuation clause, exact Stopping binding, finite reachability and outgoing-transition facts, and formal terminal-edge facts.
decisions.reason: The supplied requirement describes a reachable operating state that must retain continuation. The exact Stopping state is reachable from the initial configuration, is non-final, and has no outgoing transitions or inherited continuation. The supplied formal topology does not provide a terminal edge for Stopping; therefore its zero-outgoing frontier establishes the progress/dead-end reading. No explicit terminal clause or terminal fact supports an intentional-terminal alternative.
decisions.violated_obligation: The reachable non-final operating state Stopping must not terminate without an inherited continuation.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL3, exact EmergencyStopping/action/event bindings, source lifecycle mapping, and closed-model action observation.
decisions.reason: The NL3 clause requires EmergencyStopping to include the Emergency Stop action in the specified lifecycle context. The exact state, transition, and event are bound, and the closed model exposes EmergencyStop as an abstract entry action, but the obligation does not type an explicit action phase. The source places the action on entry, while the frozen candidate does not provide a phase field; these two compatible scope readings prevent deciding whether the observed action satisfies the precise requirement.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The source lifecycle mapping and PlantUML placement support treating Emergency Stop as an entry action for EmergencyStopping, which could satisfy the action obligation if entry is the intended phase.
decisions.violated_obligation: EmergencyStopping includes the Emergency Stop action in the source-required lifecycle context.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL3 effect clause, exact EmergencyStopping/state/event/transition bindings, and complete supplied effect observations.
decisions.reason: NL3 requires EmergencyStopping to send the Obstacle Detected signal. The exact EmergencyStopping state is bound, while the supplied closed-model inventory shows no state effect or transition effect carrying Obstacle Detected; the only outgoing transition is Obstacle_Cleared with an empty effect list. Event declaration and use as an incoming trigger do not establish emission, so no competent alternative reading rebuts the missing effect.
decisions.violated_obligation: EmergencyStopping sends the Obstacle Detected signal.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL4 containment clause, exact Accelerating/InMotion bindings, authored source inventory, canonical hierarchy, and closed-model containment facts.
decisions.reason: NL4 requires Accelerating to be contained within InMotion. The exact source inventory and closed model both identify Accelerating as root-level with no InMotion parent. A transition from InMotion to Accelerating establishes behavioral connectivity only and cannot rebut the structural containment requirement.
decisions.violated_obligation: Accelerating is structurally contained within InMotion.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL4 containment clause, exact Cruising/InMotion bindings, authored source inventory, canonical hierarchy, and closed-model containment facts.
decisions.reason: NL4 requires Cruising to be contained within InMotion. The exact source inventory and closed model show Cruising as root-level with no InMotion child scope. Transition involvement does not establish structural containment, so the supplied facts establish the wrong scope.
decisions.violated_obligation: Cruising is structurally contained within InMotion.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL4 containment clause, exact Approaching/InMotion bindings, authored source inventory, canonical hierarchy, and closed-model containment facts.
decisions.reason: NL4 requires Approaching to be contained within InMotion. The exact source inventory and closed model show Approaching as root-level with no InMotion child scope. Outgoing transitions from Approaching concern behavior and do not rebut the structural containment requirement.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching is structurally contained within InMotion.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL5 owner-local initial-entry clause, exact InMotion/Accelerating/transition bindings, source inventory, and scoped initial-edge facts.
decisions.reason: The NL5 clause requires an owner-local initial edge in InMotion entering Accelerating. The exact model contains only a normal InMotion-to-Accelerating transition, not an edge from the InMotion initial pseudostate; the root initial edge targets DoorsClosing. A normal endpoint connection or different root initial edge is a separate property and cannot satisfy this scoped initial-entry obligation.
decisions.violated_obligation: The InMotion scope has an owner-local initial edge entering Accelerating.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL8 entry clause, exact InMotion/Accelerating/transition bindings, and scoped initial-entry facts.
decisions.reason: NL8 requires InMotion to enter Accelerating when motion begins, marked by Entry/Accelerate. The exact model has no owner-local initial edge and no motion-begins trigger on the ordinary InMotion-to-Accelerating transition. Other ordinary InMotion edges, including one to a different target, do not satisfy this exact entry obligation.
decisions.violated_obligation: When motion begins, the InMotion scope enters Accelerating.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL9 effect clause, exact Approaching and outgoing-transition bindings, and complete supplied effect inventory.
decisions.reason: NL9 requires Approaching to send the Send signal and continue approaching. For the effect portion under review, the exact Approaching state has no effect field and both exact outgoing transitions have empty effect lists. Event declarations do not establish emission, so no supplied fact rebuts the missing Send effect.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching sends the Send signal.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL10 termination clause, exact Approaching/Stopping/transition bindings, reachability facts, and root-final topology.
decisions.reason: NL10 requires the Approaching retention behavior to end when the system is ready to stop or decelerate. The exact Approaching state has a Ready_to_Stop transition to Stopping and a Destination_Missed transition to the root final state; the supplied facts show completion targets and no asserted failure of stable termination. The zero-outgoing Stopping issue is a separate progress obligation and does not itself establish failure of Approaching's termination contract.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL4 cardinality clause, exact InMotion binding, complete finite source/model inventory, and explicit-member counting facts.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL5 initial-entry clause, exact InMotion and Accelerating bindings, owner-local initial-edge inventory, and S2 facts.
decisions.reason: The NL5 clause requires the InMotion scope to initially enter Accelerating. The exact owner and target are bound, and the owner-local initial transition inventory has no target, with matching edges to Accelerating marked conditional. A child-region edge or guarded routing edge would be a different property and does not satisfy the exact owner-local default-entry requirement.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL2 continuation clause, exact Stopping binding, finite reachability and outgoing-transition facts, and formal terminal-edge facts.
decisions.reason: The supplied requirement describes a reachable operating state that must retain continuation. The exact Stopping state is reachable from the initial configuration, is non-final, and has no outgoing transitions or inherited continuation. The supplied formal topology does not provide a terminal edge for Stopping; therefore its zero-outgoing frontier establishes the progress/dead-end reading. No explicit terminal clause or terminal fact supports an intentional-terminal alternative.
decisions.violated_obligation: The reachable non-final operating state Stopping must not terminate without an inherited continuation.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL6 guard clause, exact Accelerating-to-Approaching transition binding, and supplied null guard fact.
decisions.reason: The NL6 transition obligation requires the independent guard “approaches its destination.” The exact carrier transition from Accelerating to Approaching is bound and its guard is null. The event or trigger field is distinct from the required guard and cannot satisfy it, so the supplied facts establish the missing guard.
decisions.violated_obligation: The Accelerating-to-Approaching transition retains the independent guard “approaches its destination.”

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL7 guard clause, exact Cruising-to-Approaching transition binding, and supplied null guard fact.
decisions.reason: The NL7 clause requires the Cruising-to-Approaching transition to have the independent guard “approaches the destination.” The exact carrier transition is bound with guard=null. A trigger or event carrier is a different typed field and does not establish the required guard, so the obligation violation is semantically established.
decisions.violated_obligation: The Cruising-to-Approaching transition retains the independent guard “approaches the destination.”

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL1 scenario clause, exact Closed_SendDeparted stimulus and InMotion target bindings, native runtime scenario, and runtime trace.
decisions.reason: The NL1 clause requires the Closed/SendDeparted stimulus to leave the system in InMotion. The exact runtime trace shows the stimulus consumed at step 1 with InMotion active, followed by an observation step in which Accelerating is active. Thus the target is reached, but it is not retained in the trailing observation portion required by the scenario property. The supplied trace positively supports the intended transition behavior, so it rebuts the alleged wrong-target violation even though the stronger retention condition is not met.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The native runtime trace consumes Closed_SendDeparted and activates the exact InMotion target before the subsequent observation advances to Accelerating.
decisions.violated_obligation: After the exact Closed/SendDeparted stimulus, the current artifact enters and retains InMotion over the declared trailing window.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL5 Cruising transition clause, exact Accelerating-to-Cruising event/state/transition bindings, and source transition facts.

decisions.violated_obligation: After the exact Reached Cruising/Cruise stimulus, the current artifact enters Cruising.

decisions.basis: Pair 0034 dossier: NL6 and NL7 endpoint clauses, exact Approached target and source-state bindings, and supplied transition topology.
decisions.reason: The NL6 clause requires Approached/Decelerate to enter Approaching. The exact event, Approaching target, and supporting transition bindings are supplied; the dossier does not establish a different endpoint for that stimulus. The absence of an executable scenario result is not semantic evidence against the endpoint. The exact source/model endpoint facts therefore provide a reasonable rebuttal to the proposed wrong-target reading.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The exact Approached_Decelerate event and Approaching target are bound to the required endpoint, with the supplied transition topology supporting that intended route.
decisions.violated_obligation: After the exact Approached/Decelerate stimulus, the current artifact enters Approaching.
